extra_data.title: Suspicious download URL detected
extra_data.description: This issue occurs when an AI agent is directed to download from untrusted URLs.
extra_data.explanation: Downloading and running files from unverified sources is a primary vector for malware.
extra_data.evidence: This is high-risk: it uses curl | bash to fetch and execute a .sh from an untrusted domain.

extra_data.description: The skill content contains code patterns that suggest deliberate malicious behavior.
